remarks: Welcome to your dreamy seaside retreat! This 2 bdrm, 2.5 bth duplex is nestled in the Marina Bay waterfront complex. Imagine waking up just a stone's throw from the beach & only mins away from a variety of shops, parks & restaurants. Sounds too good to be true? Well, it's not! Step inside where you're welcomed by a bright, updated kitchen featuring granite counters & SS appliances. This modern kitchen seamlessly opens to a dining area w/sliders leading to a balcony w/beautiful, park-like views, or should we say your new favorite spot for morning coffee? The open-concept DR flows directly into a spacious LR that's perfect for relaxing or entertaining w/a cozy fireplace. The ML also features a tastefully updated pwdr rm & extra storage. Head upstairs to find the primary bdrm, which really has it all! Enjoy the view from your private balcony, spacious walk-in-closet & modernized en-suite bath. The large 2nd bdrm is equally inviting, filled w/natural light, double closets & access to the gorgeous hall full bth. Laundry is conveniently located right by the bdrms, c/a, natural gas & yes, this pet-friendly home means your furry friends are welcome too! As if that's not enough, there's an inground pool overlooking the stunning waterfront views. Parking is a breeze w/1 assigned spot, a floating space for a 2nd car & plenty of visitor spots. 1.5mi. to the train & I-95, commuting is a piece of cake. Who needs a vacation when you can have a staycation every day!
